Watch the lively track "Bye Bye Miss Good Night" from the classic film Prem Nagar (1974) starring the superstar Rajesh Khanna. Sung in the unique and charming voice of Kishore Kumar, this energetic number is one of the most popular songs of the 70s that still delights fans today. A perfect blend of fun, rhythm, and Rajesh Khanna’s screen charisma!
